question:
Choose the correct one-word substitution for:

“A place where dead bodies are preserved temporarily”
solution:
The correct answer is: **Morgue**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Morgue"** refers to a place where dead bodies are preserved temporarily, usually before burial or cremation. (मुर्दाघर)
 
 
• **Example:** After the tragic accident, the bodies were taken to the morgue for identification.
 
 
 
• **"Graveyard"** refers to an area, usually near a church, where dead bodies are buried. (कब्रिस्तान)
 
 
• **Example:** The graveyard was peaceful and surrounded by old trees.
 
 
 
• **"Mausoleum"** refers to a building constructed as a tomb for housing the remains of the dead. (समाधि)
 
 
• **Example:** The Taj Mahal is an iconic mausoleum built by Shah Jahan.
 
 
 
• **"Pyre"** refers to a pile of wood on which a dead body is burnt during cremation. (चिता)
 
 
• **Example:** The funeral pyre was lit as part of the final rites.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Morgue**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Graveyard **(कब्रिस्तान): A burial ground, especially one attached to a church.
 
 
• **Example:** They visited the graveyard to pay respects to their ancestors.
 
 
 
• **Mausoleum **(समाधि): A magnificent tomb or building for housing the remains of the dead.
 
 
• **Example:** The king’s mausoleum was beautifully adorned with carvings and paintings.
 
 
 
• **Pyre **(चिता): A pile or structure of wood used for burning a body during funeral rites.
 
 
• **Example:** The pyre was prepared at the cremation ground.
